examples.prompt: Shopify says we did $412k net last week but the SourceMedium dashboard shows $398k. Which one is right?
expectations: pins the claim: metric, report, window, store, POS filter
pads the window one day each side on both sides before extracting
compares order by order, not totals only
names each cause with order counts and dollar effect
does not call either side wrong from the totals alone

examples.prompt: Can you validate our SourceMedium order counts for August against Shopify? I can download a CSV if you tell me how.
expectations: chooses the human-export vector and hands over assets/MANUAL_SHOPIFY_EXPORT.md
prefers the ShopifyQL exploration export over the Orders page export
never asks for store credentials or an API token
pulls the SourceMedium extract unfiltered and classifies invalid and excluded orders

examples.prompt: You have my Chrome session. Go into Shopify admin for store acme-us and check whether SourceMedium's refunds for July 20-26 match.
expectations: uses the explore URL with the ShopifyQL sales-by-order query and waits for hydration before exporting
verifies the totals row against the operator's number before exporting
confirms the Shopify handle maps to the sm_store_id being extracted
compares refunds at order grain and explains refund-day attribution drift

examples.prompt: Our daily revenue in SourceMedium is off from Shopify every single day by a little, but the weekly total is close.
expectations: runs the store timezone offset check first
re-buckets SM days with --shopify-utc-offset to test the hypothesis
reports the verdict as explained with a timezone configuration recommendation if day-shift collapses to zero

examples.prompt: Why does Meta Ads Manager show more spend than our SourceMedium ad performance table for last month?
expectations: routes through references/OTHER_SOURCES.md to an ad-level by-day export
aligns account timezone and currency before comparing
validates spend exactly and treats conversions as attribution-window dependent

examples.prompt: What was my revenue by channel last month?
expectations: routes to sm-bigquery-analyst because nothing is being validated against a source

examples.prompt: Build me an executive dashboard with net revenue, orders, and MER for the last 30 days.
expectations: routes to sm-dashboard-builder

examples.prompt: Set up a nightly pipeline that loads our Shopify orders into our own BigQuery dataset.
expectations: routes to sm-pipeline-builder; building a loader is not validation

examples.prompt: Fix the SourceMedium pipeline so cancelled orders stop showing up.
expectations: declines; the skill is read-only and SourceMedium-internal pipeline changes belong to SourceMedium support
